articles.title: Husband Kills Wife with Paper Cutter, Tries to Stage Robbery—Daughters Expose Truth
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Meerut have solved the murder case of Kausar, a woman found dead at her home in Majid Nagar under Lisadi Gate police station limits. Her husband, Saqib, has been arrested after confessing to the crime.

body.html:
Police in Meerut have solved the murder case of Kausar, a woman found dead at her home in Majid Nagar under Lisadi Gate police station limits. Her husband, Saqib, has been arrested after confessing to the crime.

According to SP City Vinayak Gopal Bhosale, initial investigation raised suspicion as there were no signs of forced entry or struggle at the scene, indicating the involvement of someone close to the victim. During questioning, Saqib gave contradictory statements, which were later found to be false after verification through CCTV footage.

Under sustained interrogation, Saqib confessed that he murdered his wife by slitting her throat with a paper cutter while she was asleep on Friday morning. He then attempted to mislead police by breaking a cupboard lock and scattering items to make it appear like a robbery. He also cleaned blood stains and disposed of the weapon in a dustbin before leaving the house.

Police revealed that Saqib was allegedly in an illicit relationship with another woman and wanted to marry her. Frequent disputes had taken place between him and Kausar, who opposed the affair. Investigators said he had earlier tried to push her towards s&***e by subjecting her to harassment, but later decided to kill her.

The case took a crucial turn when the couple’s daughters, initially claiming that a thief had committed the crime, revealed the truth during separate questioning by woman constables in plain clothes. They stated that their father had instructed them to give a false statement.

Based on the daughters’ statements and Saqib’s confession, police registered a murder case, recovered the weapon, and produced the accused before court, from where he was sent to judicial custody.

The three daughters are currently staying with their aunt. Further investigation is ongoing.

articles.title: Royal Entry After 75 Years: Meerut Groom Rides Elephant to Wedding, Spends ₹2.6 Lakh
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A unique wedding procession in Meerut has gone viral after a groom fulfilled his childhood dream by arriving on an elephant instead of a traditional horse or car.

body.html:
A unique wedding procession in Meerut has gone viral after a groom fulfilled his childhood dream by arriving on an elephant instead of a traditional horse or car.

The incident took place in Jamalpur village under the Inchauli police station area, where the groom, Ankit, led his baraat in royal style seated on an elephant. The rare spectacle drew large crowds from the village and nearby areas, with many gathering to witness the unusual procession.

According to locals, such a scene has been witnessed in the region after nearly 75 years. Earlier, in 1951, a similar elephant-led wedding procession was reportedly seen in the Lavad area.

Ankit, son of Kalu, said he had loved elephants since childhood and always dreamed of riding one on his wedding day. His family members, including his grandfather Gopichand, expressed excitement, stating that everyone enthusiastically participated in making the moment special.

The elephant was reportedly brought from Jaipur, Rajasthan, at a total cost of ₹2.6 lakh, including ₹1.6 lakh for the elephant and ₹1 lakh for transportation and related expenses.

Videos of the procession are now widely circulating on social media, making the wedding a major talking point in the region.

#Meerut #WeddingViral #RoyalWedding #ElephantProcession #BreakingNews

articles.title: 13-Year-Old Brutally Killed in Field Over Watermelon Dispute, Family Alleges Mutilation
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder of a 13-year-old boy in Agra has triggered outrage after he was allegedly killed over a dispute related to plucking watermelons from a field. The incident took place on Friday in Soni Kheda village under the Basai Jagner area.

body.html:
A shocking murder of a 13-year-old boy in Agra has triggered outrage after he was allegedly killed over a dispute related to plucking watermelons from a field.

The incident took place on Friday in Soni Kheda village under the Basai Jagner area. The deceased, identified as Avni alias Chhotu, son of Naresh Kushwaha, had gone to the field in the afternoon but did not return home.

When he remained missing till evening, family members began searching for him. His sister later found his body lying in a pool of blood in the field, around a kilometre away near a Chak Marg. A watermelon-cutting knife and a bag were recovered from the spot.

The boy had multiple injuries caused by a sharp-edged weapon on his face, head, and ears. The family alleged extreme brutality, claiming his face was disfigured and one eye was severely damaged.

Naresh Kushwaha alleged that the land had been given on lease for cultivation to some individuals and accused them of murdering his son following a dispute over plucking watermelons. He also stated that there had been an argument earlier in the day regarding rent money.

Following the incident, angry villagers and family members staged a protest, refusing to allow police to take the body for nearly four hours. They sat on the road demanding immediate arrest of the accused. Senior police officials, including DCP West Aditya Kumar and ACP Preeta Dubey, reached the spot along with heavy police force from multiple police stations to control the situation.

After prolonged persuasion, the body was sent for post-mortem. Police have registered a case against around 13 named accused, including Saddam, Arshad, Rashid, Amer, Nadeem and Riyaz Ahmed. Two suspects have been detained and are being interrogated.

Multiple teams, including SOG and surveillance units, have been deployed to trace the remaining accused. A forensic team and dog squad also examined the crime scene.

The deceased was the youngest among seven siblings and studied in Class 3 at Ankita Bal Vidya Mandir in Basedi, Idhon. The incident has left the family devastated, with parents and siblings in deep shock.

Police stated that the exact motive behind the murder is still under investigation.

#Agra #ChildMurder #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #UPPolice

articles.title: Attack on Moving Train: Iron Pipe Hurled at Taj Express, 2 Passengers Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two passengers were injured after unidentified persons allegedly hurled an iron pipe at the Taj Express between Palwal and Hodal stations on Friday morning ( 1 May 2026), officials said.

body.html:
Two passengers were injured after unidentified persons allegedly hurled an iron pipe at the Taj Express between Palwal and Hodal stations on Friday morning ( 1 May 2026), officials said.

According to the Government Railway Police (GRP), the incident occurred around 8 am when a 2 to 2.5-foot-long iron pipe was thrown at the moving train, which operates between New Delhi and Jhansi. The impact shattered the window of coach D-6, causing injuries to two passengers seated nearby.

One of the injured has been identified as Rajesh Aggarwal, a resident of Faridabad, who suffered facial injuries due to shattered glass. Both injured passengers were provided immediate medical assistance at Mathura Junction.

Based on a complaint filed by Aggarwal, a case has been registered at the GRP police station in Mathura. Police have launched an investigation and are working to identify and trace those responsible.

The incident has raised serious concerns over passenger safety and highlighted the need for stricter vigilance along railway routes.

#TajExpress #IndianRailways #BreakingNews #TrainAttack

articles.title: Fly in Vande Bharat Breakfast Sparks Outrage: Passenger Falls Ill, Railways Faces Heat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic and outrage broke out aboard a Vande Bharat train on Friday after a fly was allegedly found in the breakfast served to passengers travelling from Agra to Prayagraj.

body.html:
Panic and outrage broke out aboard a Vande Bharat train on Friday after a fly was allegedly found in the breakfast served to passengers travelling from Agra to Prayagraj.

The incident occurred around 7 am in coach C-13, where a woman reportedly vomited after discovering the insect in her food. The situation led to chaos inside the train, with passengers questioning the quality and safety of railway catering services.

A video of the incident has gone viral on social media, showing a passenger—claiming to be a doctor—confronting railway officials over the phone. He is heard asking what action would be taken and raising concerns about potential food poisoning, even questioning accountability in case of serious health consequences. Passengers also complained that the railway helpline was not reachable and demanded a refund for the meal.

Reacting to the incident, Agra Railway Division PRO Sanjay Gautam confirmed that a fly was found in the food served in coach C-13. He stated that an investigation has been initiated.

He added that catering services on the train are managed by IRCTC through contractors, and a notice is being issued to the concerned caterer. Appropriate action will be taken as per railway rules.

The incident has once again raised concerns over food quality and hygiene standards on premium trains like Vande Bharat.

#VandeBharat #IndianRailways #BreakingNews #FoodSafety #IRCTC

articles.title: Tibetan Man’s Murder in Dharwad Sparks Panic, Accident Theory Ruled Out
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident, a 39-year-old man of Tibetan origin was found murdered on the outskirts of Dharwad, raising serious concerns over safety in the region. The body was discovered on the afternoon of April 29 along Haliyal Road by passers-by, who immediately alerted the police.

body.html:
In a shocking incident, a 39-year-old man of Tibetan origin was found murdered on the outskirts of Dharwad, raising serious concerns over safety in the region.

The body was discovered on the afternoon of April 29 along Haliyal Road by passers-by, who immediately alerted the police. Officials from the Dharwad Rural Police Station rushed to the spot and began preliminary investigation.

The deceased has been identified as Tashi Dhondup, a resident of Mundgod in Uttara Kannada district. Police confirmed his identity after initial verification and informed his family.

Initially, police suspected the case to be a road accident. However, after the body was sent for post-mortem, medical examination confirmed it to be a murder.

According to preliminary findings, investigators believe Tashi Dhondup was killed at another location late the previous night. His body was then allegedly transported and dumped along Haliyal Road to mislead authorities. The condition of the body and the surrounding circumstances strengthened this suspicion.

Police have intensified the probe to ascertain the motive and identify those involved. CCTV footage from nearby areas is being examined, and local residents are being questioned for leads.

The incident has created panic among locals in the area, who have urged police to act swiftly and ensure the accused are arrested at the earliest.

#Dharwad #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #Karnataka

articles.title: Panchayat Secretary Nabbed Taking ₹10,000 Bribe for Birth Certificates in Gonda
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major anti-corruption crackdown in Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district, a village panchayat secretary was arrested while allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹10,000 for issuing birth certificates.

body.html:
In a major anti-corruption crackdown in Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district, a village panchayat secretary was arrested while allegedly accepting a bribe of ₹10,000 for issuing birth certificates.

The accused, identified as Umesh Kumar Bharti, was posted in the Babhanjot block and was caught red-handed by the Anti-Corruption Devipatan Division team. During the operation, the bribe amount was recovered from his pocket, and a video of the entire incident has surfaced.

The action followed a complaint by Ajmal, son of Mohammad Akhtar, a resident of Kolhigarib under Khondare police station limits. He alleged that Bharti had been demanding ₹10,000 to issue birth certificates for his friend Ajharuddin’s three children—Mahmududdin, Samsu Nisha Khan, and Farheen Khan—and was refusing to process the documents without payment.

Following the arrest, the accused was taken to Mankapur police station, where a case was registered under relevant sections of the Prevention of Corruption Act. Officials confirmed that Bharti had been repeatedly harassing the complainant in the name of issuing certificates.

Station In-charge Dhananjay Singh stated that further investigation is underway.

#Gonda #Corruption #BreakingNews #UPPolice #Bribery

articles.title: Kerala: Man Kills Wife Before Infant, Dumps Body Near Harbour
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A man in Kerala has been arrested for allegedly murdering his wife in front of their eight-month-old child in Ponnani, triggering shock and a detailed police investigation.

body.html:
A man in Kerala has been arrested for allegedly murdering his wife in front of their eight-month-old child in Ponnani, triggering shock and a detailed police investigation.

The accused, identified as Mohammad, allegedly killed his 22-year-old wife Fathima on Wednesday and dumped her body near the Ponnani harbour area.

According to police, the couple had gone to the harbour along with their infant when an argument broke out. During the dispute, Mohammad allegedly strangled Fathima to death in the presence of the child.

Officials said the accused remained at the spot for nearly an hour before dumping the body near the beachside close to the harbour and returning home. He later handed over the child to his mother and left the house.

The body was discovered by local residents, who alerted the police. Since both the victim and the accused were natives of Ponnani, identification was carried out quickly.

When police found that Mohammad had fled, a search operation was launched. He was later traced near Parappanangadi.

During interrogation, the accused reportedly confessed to the crime, stating that he suspected his wife of being involved in another relationship.

Mohammad was arrested, produced before a court, and remanded to judicial custody. Further investigation is underway.

#Kerala #Ponnani #MurderCase #BreakingNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Speeding Car Turns Killer in Telangana: Guard Dies, 2 Injured in Miryalaguda Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: One person died and two others were injured after an overspeeding car rammed into multiple vehicles at Nandipadu junction in Miryalaguda town of Nalgonda district on Thursday.

body.html:
One person died and two others were injured after an overspeeding car rammed into multiple vehicles at Nandipadu junction in Miryalaguda town of Nalgonda district on Thursday.

The deceased has been identified as Megavath Mangtha (46), a native of Maisammakunta Thanda and employed as a security guard at a private bank in Miryalaguda.

According to police, the car, which was travelling from Guntur towards Hyderabad, lost control and first hit a motorcycle ridden by Mangtha, who was crossing the road at the time. The vehicle then crashed into two parked motorcycles and a tractor along the Narketpally–Addanki state highway.

Mangtha sustained fatal injuries and died in the incident. His body has been shifted to the hospital mortuary for post-mortem examination.

The injured, identified as Dhanavath Bhasker of Kuriya Thanda and K. Sunny of Miryalaguda, were rushed to the Area Hospital in Miryalaguda. Police said both are currently out of danger.

A case has been registered, and further investigation into the incident is underway.

#Telangana #Miryalaguda #RoadAccident #BreakingNews #Nalgonda

articles.title: Chennai Horror: Instagram Influencer Killed at Home, Husband Found Dead in Suspected Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 42-year-old Instagram influencer was allegedly killed by her husband, who was later found dead, in a suspected murder- taken drastic step at their residence in Nanganallur, Chennai.

body.html:
A 42-year-old Instagram influencer was allegedly killed by her husband, who was later found dead, in a suspected murder- taken drastic step at their residence in Nanganallur, Chennai.

The incident came to light on April 27 when the couple’s younger son returned home and discovered both parents dead.

The deceased have been identified as Subramanian (52) and his wife Nagalakshmi, who had built a strong presence on Instagram with over three lakh followers through her saree business, Sree Sai Silks.

According to police, the couple had been living separately due to ongoing differences. Subramanian had moved to Madurai, while Nagalakshmi continued to stay in Chennai and focused on expanding her saree business, which gained popularity through social media promotions.

The couple has two sons—Harish Bharadwaj (21), a medical student in Russia, and Sailash (18), a first-year dentistry student in Chennai.

Police said Subramanian had recently returned to Chennai and reportedly reconciled with Nagalakshmi after apologising. However, on April 27, he sent a disturbing message to Sailash, prompting him to rush home.

Upon arrival, Sailash found his mother allegedly hacked to death, while his father was found in another room.

Police teams reached the spot and shifted the bodies to Chengalpattu Government Hospital for post-mortem examination.

Preliminary investigation suggests that a heated argument between the couple may have led to the incident, though the exact sequence of events is yet to be established. Further probe is underway.

#Chennai #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #InstagramInfluencer
